source.note: The OPEN Fusion model is the source. It differs from CIANO14 12_40_fusion_params_20260925-1136.csv: motor_length 20 (CSV 10), magnet_height 5.7 (4.2), num_wires_per_slot 7 (6), insulation_thickness 0.07 (0.05), magnet_fill_up 0.34 (0.38).

profile.frame: Fusion root frame: Z = motor axis (+z = propeller/front side), first core tooth / coil / magnet centred on +Y, mm

roles.mechanics: drives the mechanical parts (shaft, bearings, holders, rings, Prop_fix, screws); CAD only, not in the simulation
roles.unsupported: ignored by the template; pre-check requires nominal
roles.foreign: other design in the Fusion file

named_parameters_sketch3.name: ax_core_ref_inset
named_parameters_sketch3.comment: Sketch3: construction line r = stator_up_r - (core_thickness - ax_core_ref_inset) (r=19); reference only
named_parameters_sketch3.role_note: construction line only (Sketch3 L8), drives nothing

named_parameters_sketch3.name: shaft_bore_tip_angle
named_parameters_sketch3.comment: Shaft: cone at the front end of the Ø6 bore (bore ends z=17.7, cone apex on axis z=20.7)

named_parameters_sketch3.name: shaft_journal_r
named_parameters_sketch3.comment: Shaft: journal radius under the 618/8 bearings (Ø8), front z 11.9..20.7, back z -15.9..-11.9
named_parameters_sketch3.role_note: Fusion '4 mm'; = bore of the bearing card (simulation config bearings)

named_parameters_sketch3.name: shaft_shoulder_len
named_parameters_sketch3.comment: Shaft: axial length of the Ø9.4 shoulder (z 11.4..11.9)

named_parameters_sketch3.name: shaft_tip_r
named_parameters_sketch3.comment: Shaft: tip radius (Ø4.901), z 20.7..36.7 = the thread section radius: ONE tip diameter over 16 mm (owner Fusion model 2026-10-16; the Ø4.95 / Ø4.9 step is gone, the M5 thread texture stays on z 28.7..36.7)

named_parameters_sketch3.name: shaft_bore_r
named_parameters_sketch3.comment: Shaft: bore radius (Ø6), z -15.9..17.7; owner Fusion model 2026-10-16: r 3.0 whatever the CAD rotor seat (r 4.95 as built), the 90 deg tip cone keeps its apex on the journal end plane
named_parameters_sketch3.role_note: Fusion '3 mm' (Sketch3 d11692); = simulation shaft_inner_radius (rotor_inner_radius 5 - shaft_height 2). Was shaft_seat_r - shaft_height (r 2.95 at the as-built seat r 4.95)

named_parameters_sketch3.name: shaft_shoulder_r
named_parameters_sketch3.comment: Shaft: shoulder radius (Ø9.4) against the front bearing inner ring

named_parameters_sketch3.name: holder_flange_t
named_parameters_sketch3.comment: Front holder: flange thickness z 11.9..13.1 (back holder flange z -13.1..-11.9 same value by symmetry)

named_parameters_sketch3.name: holder_lip_t
named_parameters_sketch3.comment: Front holder: bearing retaining lip thickness z 15.9..16.7

named_parameters_sketch3.name: bearing_od_r
named_parameters_sketch3.comment: 618/8 bearing outer radius (Ø16) = holder bearing seat radius
named_parameters_sketch3.role_note: Fusion '16 mm / 2'; = outer diameter of the bearing card

named_parameters_sketch3.name: holder_lip_r
named_parameters_sketch3.comment: Holder: bearing retaining lip inner radius (Ø14.6), front and back

named_parameters_sketch3.name: bearing_w
named_parameters_sketch3.comment: 618/8 bearing width; front seat z 11.9..15.9
named_parameters_sketch3.role_note: Fusion '4 mm'; = width of the bearing card

named_parameters_sketch3.name: shaft_front_overhang
named_parameters_sketch3.comment: Shaft: from front holder face z=16.7 to the Ø8 -> Ø4.901 step z=20.7

named_parameters_sketch3.name: shaft_thread_len
named_parameters_sketch3.comment: Shaft: length of the section next to the journal z 20.7..28.7 (Ø4.901 like the tip since 2026-10-16)

named_parameters_sketch3.name: shaft_tip_len
named_parameters_sketch3.comment: Shaft: length of the threaded end z 28.7..36.7 (Ø4.901)

named_parameters_sketch3.name: back_holder_len
named_parameters_sketch3.comment: Back holder: outer cylinder r=12 length z -20.1..-13.1

named_parameters_sketch3.name: back_holder_ref_r
named_parameters_sketch3.comment: Back holder: construction radius r=10 (outer r = ref + wall, seat r = ref - wall)

named_parameters_sketch3.name: back_holder_wall
named_parameters_sketch3.comment: Back holder: wall 2 mm each side of r=10 (seat r=8, outer r=12); d11877 = d11731
named_parameters_sketch3.role_note: driven dimension in Fusion (d11731 is not driving): back seat r = bearing_od_r, outer r = back_holder_ref_r + this

named_parameters_sketch3.name: holder_hub_wall
named_parameters_sketch3.comment: Front holder: hub wall r 8..8.8 (z 13.1..16.7)

named_parameters_sketch3.name: shaft_thread_r
named_parameters_sketch3.comment: Shaft: section next to the journal, z 20.7..28.7; = shaft_tip_r (Ø4.901, one tip diameter, owner Fusion model 2026-10-16; was Ø4.95)

named_parameters_sketch3.name: shaft_flange_step
named_parameters_sketch3.comment: Shaft: flange r = rotor bore r (5) + 2 = 7, z 10..11.4 (front rotor stop); owner 2026-10-16: 3 -> 2 mm in Fusion, balancing adds material on the rotor

named_parameters_sketch3.name: coil_holder_clearance
named_parameters_sketch3.comment: Holders: inner radius = coil corner radius (d11979) + 0.4 (r=13.633)

named_parameters_sketch3.name: ring_t
named_parameters_sketch3.comment: GFRP ring: radial thickness r 12.433..13.233

named_parameters_sketch3.name: ring_h
named_parameters_sketch3.comment: GFRP ring: axial length z 10..11.8 (front; back ring mirrored)

named_parameters_sketch3.name: ring_holder_gap
named_parameters_sketch3.comment: Axial gap ring -> holder flange (z 11.8..11.9)

named_parameters_sketch3.name: coil_corner_r
named_parameters_sketch3.fusion_expression: sqrt(( tooth_width / 2 ) ^ 2 + ( stator_up_r - core_thickness - ( insulation_thickness + ( wire_height + wire_spacing_y ) * num_wires_per_slot ) ) ^ 2)
named_parameters_sketch3.comment: Sketch3: radius of the inner corner of the winding stack (13.233); holders and ring are dimensioned from it
named_parameters_sketch3.role_note: formula of the winding inputs (Sketch3 d11979)

named_parameters_active_part.name: coil_straight_len
named_parameters_active_part.comment: Straight coil length up to the bend = stack length + 1 mm (each stack length has its own coil: L12 -> 13, L20 -> 21); drives coil_leg_length
named_parameters_active_part.role_note: named derived row used by a feature expression (owner rule 2026-10-13)

named_parameters_active_part.name: coil_straight_extra
named_parameters_active_part.comment: Coil straight legs stick out of the stack by this much in total (= coil_straight_len - motor_length = 1 mm, 0.5 mm per side)
named_parameters_active_part.role_note: read by the template code (zend, gate), not by a feature expression; derived from coil_straight_len

named_parameters_active_part.name: coil_bend_axis_dx
named_parameters_active_part.comment: x of the two end-turn bend axes (+-), = half the straight bridge between the 90-deg bends (Coil/Sketch1 L1/L3)

named_parameters_active_part.name: coil_lead_ext
named_parameters_active_part.comment: Leads: first-layer left leg and last-layer right leg extended by this beyond the coil straight end (-z)

named_parameters_active_part.name: coil_lead_len
named_parameters_active_part.comment: Leads: separate lead stubs after the extension (-z), same section wire_width x wire_height

named_parameters_active_part.name: magnet_edge_fillet
named_parameters_active_part.comment: Magnet axial-edge fillet in Fusion (no volume effect in the open model; not modelled)
named_parameters_active_part.role_note: magnet edge fillet not modelled (no volume effect in Fusion)

named_parameters_active_part.name: rotor_key_w
named_parameters_active_part.comment: Rotor: key width (key profile only used by suppressed Extrude5; not modelled)
named_parameters_active_part.role_note: rotor key not modelled (suppressed in Fusion)

named_parameters_active_part.name: rotor_key_h
named_parameters_active_part.comment: Rotor: key depth below the bore (suppressed in Fusion; not modelled)
named_parameters_active_part.role_note: rotor key not modelled (suppressed in Fusion)

named_parameters_active_part.name: core_sectors
named_parameters_active_part.comment: Stator sectors = 3 phases x num_seg (CoreSectors polar pattern)
named_parameters_active_part.role_note: named derived row used by a feature expression (no Fusion parameter of this name)

named_parameters_active_part.name: coil_count
named_parameters_active_part.comment: Coil copies = one wound tooth per stator sector (Coils array)
named_parameters_active_part.role_note: named derived row used by a feature expression (no Fusion parameter of this name)

named_parameters_active_part.name: rotor_poles
named_parameters_active_part.comment: Rotor poles = num_seg x num_poles_per_segment (RotorPoles polar pattern)
named_parameters_active_part.role_note: named derived row used by a feature expression (no Fusion parameter of this name)

named_parameters_active_part.name: magnet_count
named_parameters_active_part.comment: Magnet copies = one per rotor pole (MagnetArray)
named_parameters_active_part.role_note: named derived row used by a feature expression (no Fusion parameter of this name)

named_parameters_active_part.name: coil_layer_pitch
named_parameters_active_part.comment: Layer pitch of the winding = wire_height + wire_spacing_y
named_parameters_active_part.role_note: named derived row used by a feature expression (no Fusion parameter of this name)

named_parameters_active_part.name: coil_layer_copies
named_parameters_active_part.comment: Layers made by the pattern (the last layer is added separately) = num_wires_per_slot - 1 (CoilLayers)
named_parameters_active_part.role_note: named derived row used by a feature expression (no Fusion parameter of this name)

named_parameters_active_part.name: coil_layer_span
named_parameters_active_part.comment: Pattern length of CoilLayers: first to last patterned layer
named_parameters_active_part.role_note: named derived row used by a feature expression (no Fusion parameter of this name)

named_parameters_active_part.name: coil_leg_length
named_parameters_active_part.comment: Straight coil leg length = coil_straight_len = motor_length + 1 mm
named_parameters_active_part.role_note: named derived row used by a feature expression (no Fusion parameter of this name)

named_parameters_active_part.name: coil_x_in
named_parameters_active_part.comment: Inner x of a coil leg (centre line of the tooth to the wire)
named_parameters_active_part.role_note: named derived row used by a feature expression (no Fusion parameter of this name)

named_parameters_active_part.name: coil_top_y
named_parameters_active_part.comment: y of the top of layer 0 (under the yoke)
named_parameters_active_part.role_note: named derived row used by a feature expression (no Fusion parameter of this name)

named_parameters_active_part.name: coil_bridge_length
named_parameters_active_part.comment: Straight bridge of the end turn between the two bend axes
named_parameters_active_part.role_note: named derived row used by a feature expression (no Fusion parameter of this name)

named_parameters_active_part.name: coil_lead_total
named_parameters_active_part.comment: Lead length beyond the straight leg = coil_lead_ext + coil_lead_len
named_parameters_active_part.role_note: named derived row used by a feature expression (no Fusion parameter of this name)

named_parameters_mechanics.name: shaft_journal_end_z

named_parameters_mechanics.name: shaft_thread_end_z

named_parameters_mechanics.name: shaft_front_end_z
named_parameters_mechanics.comment: Axial chain: front end of the shaft

named_parameters_mechanics.name: back_holder_end_z
named_parameters_mechanics.comment: Axial chain: back end of the back holder = hub-boss plane A_H at z = -this

named_parameters_mechanics.name: holder_boss_len
named_parameters_mechanics.comment: Bosses run from the flange outer face to the stator end face

named_parameters_mechanics.name: ring_back_dz
named_parameters_mechanics.comment: Shift of the back ring copy (Fusion occurrence Ring:3)

named_parameters_mechanics.name: holder_inner_r
named_parameters_mechanics.comment: Holder flange outer radius = coil corner + clearance

named_parameters_mechanics.name: holder_hub_r
named_parameters_mechanics.comment: Holder hub outer radius (front hub, spoke roots)

named_parameters_mechanics.name: back_holder_outer_r
named_parameters_mechanics.comment: Back holder outer radius

named_parameters_mechanics.name: ring_inner_r
named_parameters_mechanics.comment: GFRP ring inner radius

named_parameters_mechanics.name: core_leg_outer_x
named_parameters_mechanics.comment: Outer side of the core half leg (x from the sector axis) = side of the boss seat

named_parameters_mechanics.name: holder_bolt_count
named_parameters_mechanics.comment: Holder spokes, bosses, screws and back M3 holes: one per sector boundary

named_parameters_mechanics.name: holder_bolt_r
named_parameters_mechanics.comment: Bolt circle radius (screws, bosses).  NOT dimensioned in Fusion (Sketch2 is not fully constrained): 14.843191 read from the model, rounded by the owner 2026-10-13 (Fusion not dimensioned)

named_parameters_mechanics.name: holder_window_r
named_parameters_mechanics.comment: Window fillet radius at the spoke roots.  NOT dimensioned in Fusion: 1.460021 read from the model, rounded by the owner 2026-10-13 (Fusion not dimensioned)

named_parameters_mechanics.name: holder_seat_depth
named_parameters_mechanics.comment: Boss seat depth into the stator pocket between the core legs

named_parameters_mechanics.name: holder_chamfer
named_parameters_mechanics.comment: Chamfer of the seat bottom edges along the core legs

named_parameters_mechanics.name: holder_tap_d
named_parameters_mechanics.comment: Back boss screw hole = M2 minor diameter (Fusion's thread feature sets the hole to it)

named_parameters_mechanics.name: back_holder_fillet_r
named_parameters_mechanics.comment: Fillet of the spoke ends at the back holder outer radius

named_parameters_mechanics.name: back_screw_r
named_parameters_mechanics.comment: Radius of the six M3 holes in the A_H face

named_parameters_mechanics.name: back_screw_angle
named_parameters_mechanics.comment: Angle of the M3 holes from the sector axis (on the spokes); Fusion literal 30 deg = angle_wire

named_parameters_mechanics.name: back_screw_tap_d
named_parameters_mechanics.comment: M3 hole diameter as modelled = M3 minor diameter (sketch circle 3 mm, thread feature sets the minor diameter)

named_parameters_mechanics.name: prop_fix_d
named_parameters_mechanics.comment: Prop_fix outer diameter

named_parameters_mechanics.name: prop_fix_relief_r
named_parameters_mechanics.comment: Corner relief radius of the double-D hole

named_parameters_mechanics.name: prop_fix_hub_t
named_parameters_mechanics.comment: Hub on the flats (z below the journal end)

named_parameters_mechanics.name: prop_fix_plate_t
named_parameters_mechanics.comment: Plate beyond the journal end

named_parameters_mechanics.name: prop_fix_clearance
named_parameters_mechanics.comment: Clearance of all hole faces (offset faces)

named_parameters_mechanics.name: holder_screw_req
named_parameters_mechanics.comment: Required screw length under the head: front flange outer face to the back holder inner face (L12 17.0, L20 25.0)

named_parameters_mechanics.name: screw_tip_margin
named_parameters_mechanics.comment: Least distance of the screw tip from the back flange outer face (the L12 M2x18 as built has 0.2 mm)

named_parameters_mechanics.name: holder_screw_max
named_parameters_mechanics.comment: Longest screw (length under the head) whose tip stays screw_tip_margin inside the back flange outer face (= clamp length + back flange thickness [+ rib] - margin)

named_parameters_mechanics.name: holder_screw_l
named_parameters_mechanics.source: 91292A032 family (M2 x 25 on L20, M2 x 18 on L12) in Stator_holder
named_parameters_mechanics.freecad_expression: 2 * floor(min((holder_screw_max + 0.000001 mm), 20 mm) / 2 mm) * 1 mm + 2 * min(1, floor((holder_screw_max + 0.000001 mm) / 22 mm)) * 1 mm + 3 * min(1, floor((holder_screw_max + 0.000001 mm) / 25 mm)) * 1 mm + 5 * floor(max((holder_screw_max + 0.000001 mm), 25 mm) / 5 mm) * 1 mm - 25 mm
named_parameters_mechanics.comment: Screw length under the head = the LONGEST stock length (even mm up to 20, then 22, 25, 30, ...) that fits: <= holder_screw_max (tip inside the back flange); health.precheck refuses when it is shorter than holder_screw_req (clamp length). Owner 2026-10-13: L12 M2x18, L20 M2x25; 2026-10-15: longer stacks follow (85 L15: 22)

named_parameters_mechanics.name: screw_head_d
named_parameters_mechanics.comment: Socket head diameter

named_parameters_mechanics.name: screw_head_h
named_parameters_mechanics.comment: Socket head height

named_parameters_mechanics.name: screw_head_fillet
named_parameters_mechanics.comment: Head edge radius (top and bottom)

named_parameters_mechanics.name: screw_socket_af
named_parameters_mechanics.comment: Hex socket across flats

named_parameters_mechanics.name: screw_socket_depth
named_parameters_mechanics.comment: Hex socket depth (to the drill point)

named_parameters_mechanics.name: screw_tip_chamfer
named_parameters_mechanics.comment: 45 deg chamfer at the screw tip

named_parameters_mechanics.name: screw_socket_point
named_parameters_mechanics.comment: Included angle of the drill point under the hex socket

named_parameters_mechanics.name: screw_head_top_z
named_parameters_mechanics.comment: z of the screw head top (hex socket sketch plane)

named_parameters_mechanics.name: holder_seat_z
named_parameters_mechanics.comment: z of the seat bottom faces (front +, back -); the seat chamfers sit on this plane

named_parameters_mechanics.name: seat_chamfer_tool_len
named_parameters_mechanics.comment: Length of the straight chamfer tools (symmetric about y = 0): long enough to cross every seat edge

named_parameters_mechanics.name: phase_board_n_offset
named_parameters_mechanics.comment: Phase board: N-side copper surface sits this far ABOVE the coil lead end datum (coil_lead_end_z = -(coil_leg_length / 2 + coil_lead_total)), toward the motor, so the lead ends stand out of the board by 2.525 mm.  The board thickness (1.6 +-10 %) grows toward the motor: the N side stays fixed

named_parameters_mechanics.name: phase_board_n_z0
named_parameters_mechanics.comment: Phase board STEP frame (KiCad absolute, +Z = layer A facing the motor): Z of the N-side copper surface.  A property of the STEP file, change it only with a new board export

named_parameters_mechanics.name: phase_board_x
named_parameters_mechanics.comment: Phase board STEP frame offset X: the KiCad board centre is at X 100, so the translation to the motor axis is -100

named_parameters_mechanics.name: phase_board_y
named_parameters_mechanics.comment: Phase board STEP frame offset Y: the KiCad board centre is at Y -100 (Y flipped), so the translation to the motor axis is +100

named_parameters_mechanics.name: phase_board_z
named_parameters_mechanics.comment: Phase board placement Z (translation, no rotation): N copper at coil lead end + phase_board_n_offset.  L12 -12.615 (N copper -12.825), L20 -16.615 (N copper -16.825)
